description: Get a company's income statement, balance sheet, or cash-flow statement for a given fiscal year and period, sourced from SEC Company Facts (structured XBRL), or from the issuer's regulatory filings for a listing outside the US. Returns the standard line items (e.g. revenue, net income, total assets, operating cash flow) with the latest-restated value for one exact statement period end. Quarterly flow rows are always discrete quarters: when the filer reports only cumulative year-to-date values in a currency, the quarter is derived by exact subtraction from the preceding cumulative period and marked Derived. Company-specific dimensional facts (e.g. product-segment revenue) are not included — use GetRevenueBreakdown for segment/geographic revenue, and GetFinancialFact or CompareFinancialFact for one line item across periods or across companies.

period.description: Fiscal period: 'FY' (annual) or 'Q1'..'Q4'. Defaults to the latest period with line items to show. Most filers report no discrete Q4 income/cash-flow facts in XBRL (the fourth quarter is embedded in the full-year figure) — use 'FY' for annual figures.

statement.description: Statement: 'income' (income statement), 'balance' (balance sheet), or 'cashflow' (cash-flow statement); the aliases 'is'/'p&l', 'bs' and 'cf' also work. Defaults to income.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT, GME); a listing on another exchange is MIC:TICKER (XPAR:AIR).

year.description: Fiscal year, e.g. 2023. Defaults to the year of the latest period with line items to show.

name: GetFinancialStatement
title: Financial Statements
